name: box-reveal

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the finished reveal: headline, subtitle, paragraph and button all crisp.

tagline: Colour bars sweep aside to uncover a headline block.
summary: A wrapper that hides its content behind solid colour boxes, then slides them away so the text and button fade up in place. Each box can be recoloured and timed.
appearance: On a black stage, a stack of four solid bars in white, light grey, dark grey and white again sits where a headline, subtitle, paragraph and button belong. Once revealed, that text appears in white and grey, left aligned.
behaviour: When it enters the viewport, each coloured box slides off to the right and the text beneath fades and lifts into place. The reveal plays once per mount; a Replay button re-triggers it.
demo_content: Headline Northwind., subtitle Analytics for teams who ship weekly, a trial blurb and a Start free trial button.
use_when: Hero or section copy should enter with a wipe rather than just fading in.
avoid_when: It triggers only on scroll, so copy already on screen at load may sit covered until it is scrolled past.
customise: color, duration and delay control the sliding boxes; the revealed text, layout and button come from children.
weight_why: Two motion elements animate once per view; nothing runs afterwards.

a11y.note: The reveal ignores reduced-motion preferences and runs once, so motion-sensitive users cannot opt out.

issues: Mid-reveal frames show only solid bars, so the covered state reads as empty placeholders.
polish_why: Clean wipe and fade with good type; the covered state briefly reads as placeholder bars.
